title: Netflix Platform Overview
description: Uptime, SLI/SLO, HTTP traffic and errors, latency, business KPIs, container / node / JVM resources, logs and traces for every service.

panels.title: Business KPIs   (database numbers come from the MySQL replicas through ProxySQL)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS users FROM auth_db.users
SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM auth_db.users WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
SELECT COUNT(*) AS movies FROM content_db.movies
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ready FROM content_db.movies WHERE video_status = 'READY'

panels.title: Being processed
panels.description: uploaded, waiting for or in encoding

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS processing FROM content_db.movies WHERE video_status IN ('UPLOADED','ENCODING','ENCODED')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed FROM content_db.movies WHERE video_status = 'FAILED'
SELECT COALESCE(video_status,'NONE') AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM content_db.movies GROUP BY 1
SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS count FROM content_db.movies GROUP BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at,'1d'), COUNT(*) AS "new users" FROM auth_db.users WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at,'1d'), COUNT(*) AS "movies added" FROM content_db.movies WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT created_at AS added, title, genre, video_status AS status, rating FROM content_db.movies ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT role, COUNT(*) AS users, MAX(last_login_at) AS last_login FROM auth_db.users GROUP BY role

panels.description: SLO: 95 %. Video uploads are excluded (they take minutes by nature).
